Exact_Proposed_Claim: Acute caffeine partially mitigated selected sleep-loss vigilance, cognition and military-task decrements in the reviewed military trials; this does not resolve sleep loss or establish benefit for every task.
Population: Military personnel or military-related populations under sleep deprivation, sleep restriction, or sustained wakefulness
Design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials
Transferability: International military context; Brazil applicability requires separate contextual validation.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In the sampled PMDF cohort of male officers older than 40 years, measured cardiometabolic risk burden supported consideration of surveillance; the cross-sectional study did not identify confirmed role or shift differences.
Population: Active-duty male Federal District Military Police officers aged >40 years without known atherosclerotic disease
Transferability: Direct to the sampled PMDF setting only; not generalizable to all public-safety forces.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In the studied military-police sample, leisure-time physical activity had weak cross-sectional discrimination for absence of low-back pain; it does not establish prevention or an operational cutoff.
Population: Military police from four units in Jequié, Bahia, Brazil
Transferability: Direct to sampled Bahia military police only; regional/institutional transferability uncertain.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In one small police-cadet comparison, shooting score, time and accuracy coefficient did not differ significantly by the reported stress-symptom grouping.
Transferability: Small cadet sample; no operational field-performance inference.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In the overlapping police-cadet cohort, the displayed physical-activity and several fitness measures did not show statistically significant correlations with shooting outcomes.
Source_Locator: Table 3; physical activity and physical-fitness rows
Population: 26 military police officers in the Espírito Santo Officer Training Course
Transferability: Single Brazilian police-training cohort; not independent of EV-1473 cohort family.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: A military-police record review documented more tourniquet applications in 2020–2024 than in 2013–2017; it does not establish a training effect or patient outcome.
Population: REDS occurrences documenting police application of a tourniquet in Minas Gerais
Transferability: State police record system; documentation practices and case mix may differ elsewhere.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: The evaluated Escola Segura implementation showed no statistically significant effect on the listed outcomes in the studied school setting.

Population: One Escola Segura treatment school compared with one control school; survey respondents
Transferability: One-school evaluation; short follow-up and setting-specific implementation.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: A PMPI documentary case identified service constraints and proposed a policy plan; it is organizational context, not evidence of clinical effectiveness.
Population: PMPI CAIS institutional documents and open information
Transferability: Single institutional case and proposal, not evaluated implementation.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In a Paraná occupational cohort, selected health conditions were associated with medical non-readiness; this association does not establish causality.

Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.

Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.

Population: 216 followed recruits at one Chinese police academy
Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.

Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.
